description.value: Momo Chen Cakes is a custom cake design studio specializing in elaborate wedding cakes, celebration cakes, and sweet treats such as cupcakes, cookies, cake pops, and macarons. The studio operates primarily on a consultation-and-order model, with an online shop offering a wide range of pre-designed cake options. It delivers to the Greater Vancouver area, making it a potential stop for cyclists seeking a sweet treat or special-order cake in the Richmond area.
